name: slack
description: Slack integration — channels, messages and search via official Slack MCP server (https://mcp.slack.com/mcp, OAuth 2.1).

auth.label: Connect with Slack
auth.hint: Slack does not support dynamic client registration -- create an app at api.slack.com/apps with a redirect URL of http://localhost:8765/callback, enable MCP server access under the app's Assistant settings, and paste its Client ID/Secret below.
